# `compat/schemas.js`

> **Source:** `engine/compat/schemas.js`

schemas.js — declarative schemas for the compatibility profile and its parts. Kept as plain JS descriptors (not .json) so the engine module is self-contained and needs no fetch. Validated by `schema-registry.js`'s tiny checker, which supports: type, required, enum, properties, items, additionalProperties.
